evidence_sentence: Finally, it writes the pixel indexes to the file, ensuring proper memory management throughout the process.
rationale: The fixed implementation releases whichever allocation succeeded when the other allocation fails before throwing the memory-allocation exception. The vulnerable implementation throws immediately on a partial allocation failure and does not release the successfully allocated buffer. Thus, the claim that memory management is ensured throughout the process specifically describes the fixed cleanup behavior rather than behavior common to both versions.
rewritten_docstring: The function first validates the input parameters and opens the output file for writing. It transforms the image colorspace to sRGB and allocates memory for the colormap and pixel data. It then writes the colormap to the file, handling both 256-color and higher-color images. Finally, it writes the pixel indexes to the file. If any memory allocation fails, it throws an exception.
